name: md-preview
description: Shows the Markdown files Claude edits, rendered like GitHub, in a pane next to the chat. Before and after side by side. /md opens it.

githubRenderer.title: GitHub renderer
githubRenderer.description: Render with GitHub's own renderer (gh api /markdown), which sends the file's text to GitHub under your gh login. Files git ignores are never sent. Off, everything renders on this machine.
